OnTrac Surcharges 2026 Charge
Additional Handling

An Additional Handling Charge will be assessed for any package that requires special handling or meets any of the following criteria, as determined by OnTrac in its sole discretion, including, but not limited to:

  • Packaging:
    • Any article that is not fully encased in corrugated cardboard, including but not limited to metal, wood, hard plastic, soft plastic (e.g., plastic bag), or expanded polystyrene foam (e.g., Styrofoam).
    • Any cylindrical-like item, such as a barrel, drum, pail, or tire, that is not fully encased in a corrugated cardboard shipping container that prevents it from rolling.*
    • Any package routed through the OnTrac irregular package sortation process.
    • Any other package that requires special handling, as determined by OnTrac in its sole discretion.
  • Length: Any package with the longest side exceeding 48 inches; or
  • Width: its second-longest side exceeding 30 inches; or
  • Weight: any package with an actual weight of greater than 50 pounds; or
  • Total Dimension: any package with a cubic size greater than 8,640 cubic inches.

An Additional Handling Charge will not be assessed when an Over Maximum Limits Surcharge, Unauthorized Surcharge, or Large Package Surcharge is applied. A minimum billable weight of 40 pounds will apply to any package eligible for an Additional Handling Charge.

*If this applies to your shipment, you may see "Irregular Shape/Package" on your invoice instead of "Additional Handling."

Over Max Limits

Packages with a billable weight of more than 150 pounds, or that exceed 108 inches in length, or exceed a total of 165 inches in length (longest side of the package) plus girth [(2 x width) + (2 x height)] combined are not accepted for carriage. These packages are Over Max Limits; however, if found in our system during transit, we will assess an Over Max Limits package surcharge. We reserve the right to refuse Over Max Limits packages, or upon discovery during transit to make appropriate adjustments to shipping charges. Neither an Additional Handling Charge nor a Large Package Surcharge will be assessed when an Over Max Limits Surcharge is applied.
